podcast.body: The biggest hit from "Heartbeat City" and The Cars' first major power ballad. Written by Rick Ocasic for his bandmate Ben Orr to sing, it was set off by epic Mut Lang production and became a number three hit. "And the biggest of them all, the Cars' first major power ballad, a song written by Rick Ocasic for his bandmate Ben Oar to sing, set off by epic Mutt Lang production, the number three hit draw."
